from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from pathlib import Path
imgs=sorted(Path('images').glob('*.png'))
font=ImageFont.load_default()
thumbs=[]
for p in imgs:
    im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB')
    im.thumbnail((360,260), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    canvas=Image.new('RGB',(380,300),'white')
    canvas.paste(im,((380-im.width)//2,25))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    d.text((8,6),p.name,fill='black',font=font)
    thumbs.append(canvas)
for batch in range(0,len(thumbs),12):
    subset=thumbs[batch:batch+12]
    cols=3; rows=(len(subset)+cols-1)//cols
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(cols*380, rows*300),'white')
    for i,t in enumerate(subset):
        sheet.paste(t,((i%cols)*380,(i//cols)*300))
    out=Path(f'contact_{batch//12+1}.png')
    sheet.save(out)
    print(out)
PY"
